title: 2026 Scott Addict Full Review (Bike Brands Should Be Worried)

takeaways.text: Calm, stable and predictable on descents, comfortable over cracks and potholes on wide tires, and it holds speed like a steam engine.
The integrated storage port is hidden under the down tube; optional frame bag and magnetic rear light worked well.
Flattened bar tops and a short-reach, slightly flared bar; the stem height can be adjusted along the steerer.
It does not feel lively out of the saddle; the long wheelbase and heavy wheel-and-tire package make it slow to accelerate, and there is no computer mount included.

disclosure: SCOTT lent the bike without payment; the tester was assigned the Addict 10 (SRAM Force), not the candidate's Addict 40, and the frame grade is not stated.
summary: A few weeks on the 2026 SCOTT Addict endurance bike in Addict 10 trim.
